summary_for_children: Al-Jathiyah means The Kneeling. It shows how Allah made the sea and everything in the heavens and earth useful for people, as signs for those who think.
environment_concept: A coastal world where the sea carries ships and everything in heaven and earth is set to serve people, with a kneeling crowd shown only as a symbolic horizon.
architecture_and_scenery: Busy sea lanes, fishing boats, a sky with orderly winds and an endless shore.

areas.name: Everything Subjected
areas.anchor_phrase: heavens and whatever is on the earth
areas.description: A wide view of sky and land.

activities.name: Think about it
activities.description: Find things in the scene that serve people and say thanks (adaptation).

activities.name: Winds
activities.description: Change the winds and notice them as a sign.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran
